## Repairs made this session (before recording)
The prior draft carried real defects; I verified and fixed them rather than passing them forward:
1. **`ex-the-hecke-trace-skein-calculation-for-a-three-crossing-braid`** had a literal `?` placeholder in its skein triple and asserted that σ₁σ₂σ₁ represents the trefoil. False: σ₁σ₂σ₁ = σ₁⁻¹(σ₁²σ₂)σ₁ is conjugate to the positive stabilisation of σ₁²∈B₂, so its closure is the (2,2)-torus link (**Hopf link**, 2 components — matching the half-integral powers of the value −s⁵−s). The item now verifies the skein relation on the legitimate triple (cl σ₁σ₂σ₁, cl σ₁σ₂⁻¹σ₁, cl σ₁²) via A−vB=(v−1)C, identifies the closure correctly, and checks that the 2-braid representative gives the same V.
2. **`ex-the-jones-specialization-of-a-two-strand-closure`** cross-checked the trefoil against that same wrong representative; replaced by the correct caveat.
3. **`cex-an-unnormalized-hecke-trace-is-not-markov-invariant`** had a discarded fragment (`·?`) and an ambiguous hypothesis; replaced by the exact computation (z₋/z=(z+1−v)/(vz)≠1) and the precise failure condition.
All three affected records were re-recorded with updated deps; the other 24 hashes verified unchanged. Verifications are recorded in the notes (symbolic identity plus exact rational instance v=4, s=2, u=¾, z=−12/5: P₊=P₋=1, P₀=−5/9, l⁻¹P₊−lP₋=mP₀=−5/6).
